items.question: How many main functions help determine which Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model should be used in the UAE?
items.fact: PPP model selection uses nine main functions, identified in feasibility study.

items.question: Which Federal Decree-Law number sets the general framework for public-private partnerships between UAE federal government entities and the private sector?
items.gold: Federal Decree-Law No. 12 of 2023 on Public-Private Partnerships.
items.fact: Federal Decree-Law No. 12 of 2023 governs UAE federal public-private partnerships.
